subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub make `artifact_coverage` a required Codex worker output for benign results and fail closed when proof is missing or incomplete?
rationale: This changes the authoritative scan trust boundary and can turn existing benign worker/model outputs into retries or failures, so the security-operations contract needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept after verifier repair
options.body: Fix the zero-byte coverage edge, refresh against current main, and then land the stricter fail-closed worker contract as the maintained security boundary.

options.title: Keep compatibility for now
options.body: Preserve the current worker output contract and redesign coverage proof behind a staged or default-compatible rollout.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Keep or close this draft until maintainers decide the permanent scanner coverage policy across worker and advisory paths.

recommendation.title: Accept after verifier repair
recommendation.body: Fix the zero-byte coverage edge, refresh against current main, and then land the stricter fail-closed worker contract as the maintained security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears most connected to the current main worker/spec state and recent ClawScan worker expansion, making them the best available routing owner for the contract decision.
